title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series: The Final: Dural
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｔｈｅ Ｆｉｎａｌ 「デュラル」
overview:
Get close to the true faces of the fighters! All 10 titles on sale now.

The Final closes the Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series with a CG graphic collection devoted to Dural, the chrome-skinned final opponent of Virtua Fighter. This limited, not-for-sale disc was offered as a prize to players who sent in coupons from five volumes of the series.

The back of the case shows all ten regular volumes: Sarah, Jacky, Akira, Pai, Wolf, Lau, Shun, Lion, Kage and Jeffry.

戦士たちの素顔にせまる!
全10タイトル好評発売中。
